newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK TOBACCO FIRM TO LAUNCH NEW ANTI-SMOKING FILTER.
newsitem.headline: GREEK TOBACCO FIRM TO LAUNCH NEW ANTI-SMOKING FILTER.

text.p: Greek cigarette manufacturing company SEKAP will present a new cigarette filter that is supposed to drastically reduce the risks of smoking, the company said in a statement.

"The 'bio-filter' which uses haemoglobin, the body's oxygen-carrier, has performed well in trials in screening out short-lived carcinogens that are not stopped by ordinary cigarette filters," the statement said "The new filter will be presented on January 22."
The filter was developed by three Greek physicians and does not affect the taste of cigarettes and would be slghtly more expensive than existing filters, it added.
Greeks are among the heaviest smokers in the world.
